أستحثث (form X)
# أَسْتَحْثِثْ (ʔastaḥṯiṯ) /ʔas.taħ.θiθ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
# أُسْتَحْثَثْ (ʔustaḥṯaṯ) /ʔus.taħ.θaθ/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
